name: token-diet
description: Aggressive token reduction for OMP dev teams: ctx-wire for transparently compressed + secret-scrubbed shell output (with EN+FR multilingual filters for git/dotnet), context-mode for language-agnostic output sandboxing, CodeGraph (MCP) for symbol/call-graph queries instead of grep+read, a caveman terse-output skill, a yagni minimal-code skill (ponytail-style), plus context-transform extensions: lossless read-dedup + context-dedup (on by default) and a protect-masked context compressor (safe-level on by default, lite/full opt-in — the quality-preserving take on caveman-code's LLMLingua/Provence). Layers on top of OMP's native compaction + astGrep/summarizeCode.
